blocking_findings: P3X1-1 [Blocker] adversarial-testing: adjudicate.ts queue merges two different claims into one queue item when the title and reason differ only by a whitespace shift. Rationale: claimKey (adjudicate.ts:253) joins the claim fields with a space, so title "a b" + reason "c" and title "a" + reason "b c" share one dedup key, while claimId (adjudicate.ts:259, JSON.stringify) gives two ids; the queue of spec D11 ("two different claims get two ids") keeps one item, the loser never gets a verdict, and a false-claim loser escapes the score.

P3X1-2 [Major] adversarial-testing: review-set.ts lint passes a plant at new_lines [9999, 9999] that lies on no hunk of its diff. Rationale: readDiff checks operator, length, removed-line crossing, spacing, hunk headers, and SHA-256, but never checks that a plant range sits on diff lines, so a plant that changes no + line of the source diff (spec D5) passes FR-8 and its weight counts in W although no route can find it.
